concepts.name: Properties of Squares and Rectangles
concepts.description: Students explore the characteristics of squares and rectangles by observing their sides, angles, and vertices. They compare these shapes to understand their similarities and differences.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify squares and rectangles based on their properties.

concepts.name: Recognizing Shapes in Daily Life
concepts.description: Everyday objects such as tiles, windows, books, and chessboards are used to recognize squares and rectangles in the surrounding environment.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify square and rectangular shapes in real-life objects.

concepts.name: Counting Unit Squares
concepts.description: Students count equal-sized squares arranged in grids to determine the size of different figures. This develops visual reasoning and counting strategies.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to count unit squares accurately in regular figures.

concepts.name: Hidden and Overlapping Squares
concepts.description: Larger squares can be formed by combining smaller unit squares. Students learn systematic methods to identify all possible squares in a figure.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and count hidden or overlapping squares in a grid.

concepts.name: Logical Counting Strategies
concepts.description: Organized counting techniques reduce errors and ensure that every square is counted exactly once.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to apply systematic strategies to count geometric figures accurately.

concepts.name: Area as Surface Coverage
concepts.description: Area measures the amount of surface covered by a shape. Unit squares provide a simple way to understand and calculate area.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain area as the number of square units covering a figure.

concepts.name: Measuring Area with Unit Squares
concepts.description: Students estimate and determine the area of regular and irregular shapes by counting square units.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to calculate the area of figures by counting unit squares.

concepts.name: Comparing Areas
concepts.description: Shapes with different appearances may have equal or different areas depending on the number of square units they contain.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to compare the areas of different shapes using square units.

concepts.name: Patterns in Square Grids
concepts.description: Square grids can be used to create repeating designs, tessellations, and mathematical patterns that strengthen spatial reasoning.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and extend geometric patterns formed using square grids.

concepts.name: Spatial Visualization
concepts.description: Students develop the ability to mentally rotate, combine, and decompose shapes while solving grid-based puzzles.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to visualize and manipulate shapes within square grids.

concepts.name: Understanding Squares and Area
concepts.description: This chapter develops visual reasoning by exploring squares, counting techniques, area measurement using unit squares, and geometric patterns.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify, count, compare, and use square units to determine the area of simple figures.
